notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1790). Words follow the Peters engraving's spelling and punctuation: poss' io, poch' ore and bell' idol as two words (pɔs + ˈi.o, pɔk + ˈo.re, bɛll + ˈi.dol), “or or” as two words (the print hyphenates them “or-or”), Ferrando's and Guglielmo's “Ah tu sei” in bar 44, and the asides in brackets as printed. IPA, word meanings and translations come from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts (L37, IPA checked against Castel), repeated where the score repeats the text; repeated fragments have short literal translations. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
